title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing — Funding, Promotional End Date and First Payment
content:
A Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing loan is funded only after the customer has signed the installation completion certificate for the financed contract. Funding happens within the stated business days after completion and pays the financed amount to the contract as lender funding. The promotional end date is the funded date plus the plan's promotional months, counted in calendar months; when the same day does not exist in the end month it falls back to the last day of that month. The first payment is due on the account's due day that falls at least the stated number of days after funding, and the scheduled monthly payment is the plan's payment factor per 1,000.00 times the financed amount, rounded to the cent, never below the plan minimum payment.

## Authorisation to fund

The completion certificate must be signed for the very contract the account finances; the installation completion on record for that contract is the evidence, read before funding. Each plan's funding window is its stated number of business days after installation completion.

## What funding books

- The financed amount is paid to the contract as lender funding.
- The funded principal is booked to the financing account on the funding date.
- The account moves from approved to active.

## Promotional end date (hypothetical dates)

| Funded date | Promotional months | Same day in end month exists? | Promotional end date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-15 | 12 | Yes | 2027-01-15 |
| 2026-08-31 | 18 | No (no 31 February 2028) | 2028-02-29 |

## First due date (hypothetical case)

A loan funded on 10 March with a due day of the 1st and the plan's minimum of 25 calendar days: 1 April is only 22 days after funding, so the first payment falls on 1 May, 52 days after funding.

## Scheduled monthly payment (hypothetical inputs)

| Financed amount | Factor per 1,000.00 | Factor times amount, rounded | Floor | Scheduled monthly payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7250.00 | 19.80 | 143.55 | 25.00 | 143.55 |
| 1200.00 | 19.80 | 23.76 | 25.00 | 25.00 |

The amounts, factors and dates above are illustrative inputs, not plan terms.
